# Search Box

A dedicated search field with a leading search icon, a clear action that appears while typing, the library's bottom press line on focus, and error, read-only, and disabled states. Ported from the DGA library's dga-search-box component.

**Stylesheet:** `components/search-box/search-box.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/search-box.js` (classes `SearchBoxManager`); wired through `[data-search-clear]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for configuring search boxes, mapped from the library's dga-search-box API.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.search-box` | Base | — | 40px field with a gray-400 border; hover darkens it to gray-700. |
| .search-box.focus / .active | State | — | Focus grows the bottom press line to full width; active (pressed) shows 50%. |
| `.search-box--error` | State | `error` | Error border and press line, usually with the error feedback icon. |
| .search-box--readonly / --disabled | State | readonly, disabled | Muted field without the press line; disabled also mutes the icons. |
| .search-box__icon / .search-box__field | Element | `placeholder` | Leading 20px search icon and the borderless input. |
| .search-box__actions / __action-btn / __divider | Element | — | Trailing actions (clear, optional search button) separated by a 1px divider. The page script shows them only while the field has text. |
| `.search-box__feedback-icon--success\|--error\|--warning` | Element | `feedback` | Status icon with a soft tinted halo before the actions. |

## Default

Type in the field: the clear action appears with its divider, and clearing refocuses the input.

```html
<div class="search-box" style="max-width: 360px;">
    <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
    <input type="text" class="search-box__field" placeholder="Search services..." aria-label="Search">
    <div class="search-box__actions" style="display:none;">
        <button type="button" class="search-box__action-btn" data-search-clear="" aria-label="Clear search">
            <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
        </button>
        <span class="search-box__divider"></span>
        <button type="button" class="search-box__search-btn" aria-label="Search">
            <span class="icon dga-icon-search-01"></span>
        </button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Validation & States

Error recolors the border and press line; success shows the tinted check; read-only and disabled mute the field.

```html
<div class="search-box search-box--error" style="max-width: 260px;">
    <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01"></span></span>
    <input type="text" class="search-box__field" placeholder="Error" aria-label="Search with error">
    <span class="search-box__feedback-icon search-box__feedback-icon--error"><span class="icon dga-icon-cancel-circle"></span></span>
</div>
<div class="search-box" style="max-width: 260px;">
    <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01"></span></span>
    <input type="text" class="search-box__field" value="National services" aria-label="Search success">
    <span class="search-box__feedback-icon search-box__feedback-icon--success"><span class="icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span></span>
</div>
<div class="search-box search-box--readonly" style="max-width: 260px;">
    <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01"></span></span>
    <input type="text" class="search-box__field" value="Read-only query" readonly="" aria-label="Read-only">
</div>
<div class="search-box search-box--disabled" style="max-width: 260px;">
    <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01"></span></span>
    <input type="text" class="search-box__field" placeholder="Disabled" disabled="" aria-label="Disabled">
</div>
```

## RTL Layout

The icon leads from the right and the actions trail on the left.

```html
<div class="search-box" style="max-width: 360px;">
    <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
    <input type="text" class="search-box__field" placeholder="ابحث في الخدمات..." aria-label="بحث">
    <div class="search-box__actions" style="display:none;">
        <button type="button" class="search-box__action-btn" data-search-clear="" aria-label="مسح">
            <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
        </button>
    </div>
</div>
```
